extDesc.message: Click any text or image on a webpage to edit it locally. Changes are local only and reset on reload.

welcomeIntro.message: Edit any webpage locally. Click text to rewrite it, click images to swap them. No developer tools required.

welcomeStep1Body.message: Click the HAKR icon in your browser toolbar.

welcomeStep2Body.message: Press “Start editing” to enable edit mode on the current page. The popup closes automatically.

welcomeStep3Body.message: Click any text to rewrite it inline. Click any image to replace it with a URL or a file from your computer.

welcomeStep4Body.message: Open the popup again to stop editing, or reset the page to undo all your changes.

welcomeNoteLocal.message: All changes are local. Only you see them - nothing is saved or sent anywhere.

welcomeNoteEphemeral.message: Reloading the page restores the original content.

welcomeNoteRestricted.message: HAKR cannot run on browser-internal pages (chrome://, about:, etc.) or extension stores.

welcomeShortcutBody.message: Press Ctrl+Shift+H (⌘+Shift+H on Mac) on any page to toggle edit mode without opening the popup.
